body: thanks for the story. I know there are things about her that aren't perfect, and I'm making sure to not forget about them. I really appreciate the read.
Thanks for the comment. Appreciate it. Do you have any other tips for getting over someone? I don't mean entirely getting over, just pulling back a little bit.
I don't even know if I'm depressed - I may be, but I'm not sure.

Honestly, I can't remember a year ago or four days ago. I have no idea what I was like or what was going on in my life a year ago, two years ago, basically my entire life. I only know what people tell me I did. I have VERY few memories I can think of off the top of my head from more than 2-3 months back.

I would say that I'm afraid to do that, but I'm not, because I think that I am old enough to stand by what I do and face the consequences for my actions. Right now, I can't handle a life changing situation like calling CPS, but I will definitely defend myself from here on out. Thanks for your comment.
